Substituting the debut would change the record; the reissue's year and label could not be verified.

Nagisa Ni Te — On the Love Beach: Bandcamp Daily describes it, but MusicBrainz's Nagisa ni te discography has no release with this title and gives no English title for any release; the year cannot be verified without guessing.
Mohamed Rouicha — Ma Nagai Ana-jay: no release with this title could be found on MusicBrainz or Wikipedia, so its year, label and format cannot be verified.
